Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring voter approval of certain city assumptions of water-sewer districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to city assumption of watersewer districts; andadding a new section to chapter 35.13A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city may not assume, under this chapter, the jurisdiction of allor part of a watersewer district serving a population greater thanthirty thousand residents and containing, within its boundaries, theterritory of four or more cities, or three cities and unincorporatedterritory of more than five hundred acres, unless voters of the entirewatersewer district approve a ballot proposition authorizing theassumption under general election law. The cost of the election shallbe borne by the city seeking approval to assume jurisdiction of awatersewer district.
